title: Normalized degree-zero base change to the fraction field
statement: Let A be a domain with fraction field K, X a quasi-compact scheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A) a separated morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], and L a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent]. Form X_K=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(A)}\operatorname{Spec}(K) [def-pc-base-change], with projections g:X_K\to X and f_K:X_K\to\operatorname{Spec}(K). Use scalar actions induced by f and f_K. There exists a K-linear isomorphism e:K\otimes_A\Gamma(X,L)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(X_K,g^*L) such that e(1\otimes s)=\eta_L(s) for every global section s, where g^* is the categorical module pullback and \eta is its adjunction unit [def-pc-module-pullback]. No valuation, properness, flatness of f, finite presentation, or triviality is assumed.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology, degree zero and its canonical section comparison; used in Tag 0EX8 general-case proof

proof.text: A fraction field is flat over its domain. Apply H.baseChange_bijective_of_isSeparated at q=0 to f and L. This gives the K-linear comparison isomorphism on Ext-based degree-zero cohomology.

Identify degree-zero cohomology with sections using H.zeroLinearEquiv, restricting scalars through the displayed structure maps. Tensor the inverse identification on X and compose with the preceding comparison and the identification on X_K. This yields the asserted K-linear isomorphism.

Track the degree-zero section augmentation through H.zeroLinearEquiv and the inverse-image coefficient adjunction defining H.baseChangeLinear. On 1 tensor s the comparison gives the adjunction-unit image of s. This is the normalization in the degree-zero Cech inverse-image comparison. The formula also holds on empty X.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_fractionField_sections_baseChange
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A]
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace X]
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) [IsSeparated f]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsQuasicoherent] :
    let g := pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A K)))
    let fK := pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A K)))
    let M := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom).obj
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤)).obj L)
    let MK := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv ≫ fK.appTop).hom).obj
      ((SheafOfModules.evaluation _ (op ⊤)).obj ((Modules.pullback g).obj L))
    ∃ e : K ⊗[A] M ≃ₗ[K] MK,
      ∀ s : Γ(L, ⊤), e (1 ⊗ₜ[A] s) =
        ((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).unit.app L).app ⊤ s
